title: Ramified recovery preserves the original four endpoints
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D with algebraic closure k [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime l distinct from D.p, finite extensions E and L of Q_l [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], an algebra map i:E→L, a positive ramification index e with the actual uniformizer-ideal equality, a finite-type k-scheme T, and a SystemLevelLeftExtensionTheory S on its pro-etale site [def-pur-system-level-left-extension-basic]. Write B for the strict L-coefficient tower [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site] and r(n)=e(n+1)-1 [def-sf-positive-ramification-subsequence]. Suppose N is a derived B_r-system with invertible transition-adjoints, and every level N_n is finite-Tor constructible [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], has cohomology in [a,b], and has Tor amplitude [c,d] [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. Then each level of the actual selected left extension L_r(N) is finite-Tor constructible [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], has cohomology in the same [a,b], and has Tor amplitude in the same [c,d]. These are the four original endpoints, independently of the output index. There is no adjunction-isomorphism or normalization-preservation conclusion in this statement.

proof.text: At index m, selectedDerivedBelow identifies recovery with extension of N at t(m) along the positive quotient A_{L,r(t(m))+1}→A_{L,m+1}. Balanced derived tensor associativity identifies the tensor test by a target module with the source tensor test after restriction of that module. Therefore the interval [c,d] is unchanged.

proof.text: Keep the independent cohomological interval [a,b]. At each stalk on each constructible stratum the input is a perfect complex over the local Artinian DVR quotient: bounded finite cohomology and finite Tor amplitude give a bounded finite free representative. Cancel every invertible differential entry to obtain a minimal representative. If its least nonzero degree were below a, a nonzero socle vector in that term would be a cycle and could not be a boundary; if its greatest degree were above b, its top cokernel would be nonzero by Nakayama. Thus the minimal representative has support in [a,b]. Extending it to a smaller positive quotient leaves that support unchanged. This proves both cohomological endpoints, without replacing them by the Tor endpoints. Apply the evaluation isomorphism to transfer all assertions to each recovered level. On a common constructible stratum the locally constant perfect input admits such finite free representatives locally. Extension preserves their finite free terms, hence the finite locally constant cohomology of the output. Refine the original finite constructible stratification to obtain intrinsic constructibility, without an exceptional scalar-mate theorem.

theorem ramifiedSystemRecoveryBounds
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E L : FieldStage.{u} l) (i : E.carrier →ₐ[Padic l] L.carrier)
    (e : ℕ+) (_he : PurCompactSupport.Ramification l E.carrier L.carrier i e)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [T.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (T ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (T ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (S : SystemLevelLeftExtensionTheory.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (C := T.ProEt) (J := Scheme.ProEt.topology T)) :
    let B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1} :=
      coefficientSequenceCommRingSystem.{u, u} l L.carrier T
    let r := Etale.SystemProjection.cofinalRamification e
      (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr e.ne_zero)
    ∀ (N : DerivedCategory (StrictRingSystem.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (selectedSystemRings.{u + 1, u, u + 1} B r))) (a b c d : ℤ),
      (∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n),
        IsIso (((systemDerivedTensorAdj.{u + 1, u, u + 1} S.scalar
          (selectedSystemRings.{u + 1, u, u + 1} B r) h).homEquiv _ _).symm
          ((SystemLevelLeftExtensionTheory.transition.{u + 1, u, u + 1} S
            (selectedSystemRings.{u + 1, u, u + 1} B r) h).app N))) →
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        finiteTorConstructible l L.carrier (r n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos _) T
          ((derivedSystemEvaluation.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
            (selectedSystemRings.{u + 1, u, u + 1} B r) n).obj N) ∧
        ((derivedSystemEvaluation.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
            (selectedSystemRings.{u + 1, u, u + 1} B r) n).obj N).IsGE a ∧
        ((derivedSystemEvaluation.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
            (selectedSystemRings.{u + 1, u, u + 1} B r) n).obj N).IsLE b ∧
        HasProEtaleTorAmplitude T (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L.carrier (r n + 1))
          ((derivedSystemEvaluation.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
            (selectedSystemRings.{u + 1, u, u + 1} B r) n).obj N) c d) →
      ∀ m : ℕ,
        finiteTorConstructible l L.carrier (m + 1) (Nat.succ_pos _) T
          ((derivedSystemEvaluation.{u + 1, u, u + 1} B m).obj
            ((S.selected B r).derived.obj N)) ∧
        ((derivedSystemEvaluation.{u + 1, u, u + 1} B m).obj
            ((S.selected B r).derived.obj N)).IsGE a ∧
        ((derivedSystemEvaluation.{u + 1, u, u + 1} B m).obj
            ((S.selected B r).derived.obj N)).IsLE b ∧
        HasProEtaleTorAmplitude T (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L.carrier (m + 1))
          ((derivedSystemEvaluation.{u + 1, u, u + 1} B m).obj
            ((S.selected B r).derived.obj N)) c d
